content:
Maya: FYI — OrbitLabs EBR is locked for Fri 9am PT. Need final deck + one-pager of asks by Thu EOD. Please limit to 8 slides.
Diego: I'll take the health & uptime slide. Will pull 30/7 day p99 and request throughput.
Priya: I'll own onboarding status + blockers. Current state: data ingestion 95% done, SDK adoption 3/5 teams, two outstanding integration tickets.
Liam: I'll do adoption signals slide (active routes, embedding uptake) and short demo of recent flow. Need a small token cap for demo.
Maya: Top 3 exec asks draft: 1) Approve renewal discount floor to keep retention, 2) Funding for a 3-month Dedicated pilot, 3) Exec intro to Orbit CTO for procurement. Thoughts?
Priya: Add request: commit to three enablement workshops (dates proposed). That helped in other accounts.
Anna (Finance): Renewal committed ARR number for Orbit: $750,000. Posted in tracker with renewal window and upsell assumptions.
Maya: Perfect, will use that in the one-pager.
Diego: Prom queries: p99 latency = `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`. Throughput = `sum(rate(requests_total[1m]))`. Will push charts to the shared deck.
legal-bot: Reminder: Orbit legal requires logo approval and no customer-identifying quotes without consent. Use aggregated metrics only.
Liam: Noted. I'll use anonymized callouts and aggregate NPS only.
slides-bot: Template created at /Shared/EBR/OrbitLabs/. Please upload final slides by Thu 5pm PT. Auto-check scheduled Thu 5:05pm.
Priya: Quick ask — can CX share the last three enablement attendance lists? Need to show engagement trend. @Diego can you ping CX?
Diego: Pinged CX in #customer-success-cx. They said they'll export and drop CSV by EOD Wed.
Maya: Let's schedule a 20-min dry run Thu 6pm PT. If that doesn't work, propose Fri 8am for a quick sync.
Liam: Thu 6pm works for me. Will rehearse demo failover: `- recorded demo; - smaller model flag; - pre-warm cache`.
Priya: I'll upload draft slides (2-3) tonight for comments.
Anna (Finance): FYI flagged a risk: discount ask may reduce ARR recognition timing. I put notes in the tracker.
Maya: We'll put that in the risks slide and suggest mitigations (time-bound pilot, usage milestones).
Diego: Also adding a short incident summary: last week had a spike due to bad batch job, fixed with patch and retry window. Put a 1-line root cause + mitigation.
Maya: Great. Final checklist: slides uploaded by Thu 5pm, finance number in sheet (done), legal ok on NPS (ack), dry-run Thu 6pm. Call out blockers here.
Priya: No blockers from my side.
Liam: Demo infra check scheduled Thu 3pm with eng-run.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll assemble the one-pager after drafts land. :thumbsup:
